name: Error Rate Spike Alert
description: Fires when error log count in any 5-minute window exceeds 20 events or spikes 3x vs the 1-hour baseline. Maps to the error-rate-spike tag in RUNBOOK.md.

_meta.note: To activate this rule: POST to Kibana API /api/alerting/rule after setting up a Slack connector at /api/actions/connector. See docs/RUNBOOK.md#kibana-alert-setup for step-by-step instructions.
manual_setup_steps: 1. Open Kibana → Stack Management → Rules and Connectors
2. Create a Slack connector with your webhook URL
3. Create a new rule: type=Elasticsearch query, index=logs-*, query=log.level:error, threshold=20 per 5m
4. Add Slack action with the message template above
